Lane 07

Bowling Bear

10 frames

Ten-pin bowling for up to four round one phone or tablet, or for phones on the same Wi-Fi. There is no server: phones connect by scanning each other's QR codes.

Bear: “Realistic Animated Bear 3D Model” by WildMesh 3D, CC BY 4.0
